subject.title: refactor: replace hardcoded ~/.openclaw paths with resolveStateDir()

question: When QQBot media resolution sees the established `OPENCLAW_HOME` contract and the proposed canonical `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` contract, what documented precedence should upgrades preserve?
rationale: The current QQBot comments explicitly protect `OPENCLAW_HOME` behavior, while the proposed refactor redirects the same paths through a resolver with different inputs; resolving that compatibility policy cannot safely be inferred from this conflicted branch.

options.title: Preserve both environment contracts
options.body: Define and test a single documented precedence that keeps existing `OPENCLAW_HOME` media locations compatible while allowing the state-directory override where intended.

options.title: Adopt state-directory-only media paths
options.body: Approve the behavior change explicitly, document the upgrade impact, and provide a migration or recovery path for existing QQBot media.

recommendation.title: Preserve both environment contracts
recommendation.body: Define and test a single documented precedence that keeps existing `OPENCLAW_HOME` media locations compatible while allowing the state-directory override where intended.
